ucs.title: [LLM] APT29 / Midnight Blizzard — OAuth service-principal credential addition paired with high-privilege Graph/Exchange consent
ucs.description: Hunts the NOBELIUM / Midnight Blizzard signature post-password-spray persistence chain that powered the 2023-24 Microsoft corporate-mailbox compromise: an attacker adds a new PasswordCredential or KeyCredential to an OAuth service principal (T1098.001) within ±24h of that same SP being granted a high-risk application/delegated permission (Mail.Read, full_access_as_app, Directory.ReadWrite.All, RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory) — the trademark SVR (Cozy Bear / IRON RITUAL) move that converts a single password-sprayed identity into long-lived mailbox-as-app access.
ucs.splunk:
index=o365 sourcetype="o365:management:activity" Workload=AzureActiveDirectory
  (Operation="Add service principal credentials."
   OR Operation="Update application \u2013 Certificates and secrets management "
   OR Operation="Update application"
   OR Operation="Update service principal"
   OR Operation="Add app role assignment to service principal."
   OR Operation="Add delegated permission grant."
   OR Operation="Consent to application.")
| eval sp_id=coalesce('Target{}.ID', ObjectId)
| eval actor=coalesce(UserId, "system")
| eval new_vals=mvjoin('ModifiedProperties{}.NewValue', "|")
| eval is_credadd=if(match(Operation, "(?i)credentials|Certificates and secrets") AND match(new_vals, "(?i)PasswordCredential|KeyCredential|KeyDescription"), 1, 0)
| eval is_highrisk_grant=if(match(Operation, "(?i)consent|role assignment to service principal|delegated permission") AND match(new_vals, "(?i)Mail\.Read|Mail\.ReadWrite|Mail\.ReadBasic|full_access_as_app|Directory\.ReadWrite\.All|Application\.ReadWrite\.All|RoleManagement\.ReadWrite\.Directory"), 1, 0)
| where is_credadd=1 OR is_highrisk_grant=1
| stats min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen sum(is_credadd) as cred_adds sum(is_highrisk_grant) as risky_grants values(Operation) as ops values(actor) as actors dc(ClientIP) as src_ip_count values(ClientIP) as src_ips values(new_vals) as modified_properties by sp_id
| where cred_adds>=1 AND risky_grants>=1
| eval window_hours=round((last_seen-first_seen)/3600,2)
| where window_hours<=24
| table first_seen last_seen window_hours sp_id actors src_ips ops modified_properties
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let HighRiskScopes = dynamic([
    "Mail.Read", "Mail.ReadWrite", "Mail.ReadBasic", "full_access_as_app",
    "Mail.Read.Shared", "MailboxSettings.ReadWrite",
    "Directory.ReadWrite.All", "Application.ReadWrite.All",
    "RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory", "AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All"
]);
let CredAdds =
    CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in~ ("Add service principal credentials.",
                            "Update application \u2013 Certificates and secrets management.",
                            "Update application.",
                            "Update service principal.")
    | extend RawText = tostring(RawEventData)
    | where RawText has_any ("PasswordCredential", "KeyCredential", "KeyDescription")
    | project CredAddTime = Timestamp,
              SPName = ObjectName,
              SPId = ObjectId,
              Actor = AccountDisplayName,
              ActorIP = IPAddress,
              ActorISP = ISP,
              ActorUA = UserAgent;
let HighRiskGrants =
    CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in~ ("Add app role assignment to service principal.",
                            "Add delegated permission grant.",
                            "Consent to application.")
    | extend GrantBlob = tostring(RawEventData)
    | where GrantBlob has_any (HighRiskScopes)
    | project GrantTime = Timestamp,
              SPName = ObjectName,
              SPId = ObjectId,
              GrantActor = AccountDisplayName,
              GrantIP = IPAddress,
              GrantBlob;
CredAdds
| join kind=inner HighRiskGrants on SPId
| where abs(datetime_diff('hour', CredAddTime, GrantTime)) <= 24
| extend HighRiskScopesSeen = extract_all(strcat("(?i)", strcat_array(HighRiskScopes, "|")), GrantBlob)
| project CredAddTime, GrantTime,
          SPName, SPId,
          Actor, ActorIP, ActorISP, ActorUA,
          GrantActor, GrantIP, HighRiskScopesSeen
| order by CredAddTime desc

ucs.title: [LLM] APT29 / NOBELIUM AD FS post-exploitation — FoggyWeb / MagicWeb DLL masquerade loaded by Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceHost.exe
ucs.description: Detects DLLs whose filename mimics canonical Microsoft.IdentityServer.* assemblies (Diagnostics, WebExtension, ServiceRuntime, Service, ServiceHost) being loaded by the AD FS service host process from a non-GAC / non-WinSxS / non-ADFS-install path. This is the on-disk signature of NOBELIUM's FoggyWeb passive backdoor and MagicWeb authentication backdoor (both attributed by Microsoft Threat Intelligence to APT29 / Cozy Bear), which side-load into the AD FS service to steal the token-signing certificate, exfil the AD FS configuration database, and forge claims for Golden-SAML-style cloud pivots.
ucs.splunk:
`sysmon` EventCode=7 Image="*\\Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceHost.exe"
  (ImageLoaded="*\\Microsoft.IdentityServer.Diagnostics.dll"
   OR ImageLoaded="*\\Microsoft.IdentityServer.WebExtension.dll"
   OR ImageLoaded="*\\Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceRuntime.dll"
   OR ImageLoaded="*\\Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceHost.dll"
   OR ImageLoaded="*\\Microsoft.IdentityServer.Service.dll")
  NOT (ImageLoaded="*\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\assembly\\*"
       OR ImageLoaded="*\\Windows\\assembly\\NativeImages_*"
       OR ImageLoaded="*\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*"
       OR ImageLoaded="*\\Program Files\\Active Directory Federation Services\\*")
| eval signed_clean=if(match(Signed, "(?i)true") AND match(SignatureStatus, "(?i)Valid"), 1, 0)
| stats min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(ImageLoaded) as loaded_dlls values(Hashes) as hashes values(Signed) as signed values(SignatureStatus) as sig_status sum(signed_clean) as clean_sig_count count by host Image
| where clean_sig_count < count
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let AdfsAssemblyNames = dynamic([
    "microsoft.identityserver.diagnostics.dll",
    "microsoft.identityserver.webextension.dll",
    "microsoft.identityserver.serviceruntime.dll",
    "microsoft.identityserver.servicehost.dll",
    "microsoft.identityserver.service.dll"
]);
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceHost.exe"
| extend LcName = tolower(FileName), LcPath = tolower(FolderPath)
| where LcName in (AdfsAssemblyNames)
| where not(LcPath startswith @"c:\windows\microsoft.net\assembly\")
    and not(LcPath startswith @"c:\windows\assembly\nativeimages_")
    and not(LcPath startswith @"c:\windows\winsxs\")
    and not(LcPath startswith @"c:\program files\active directory federation services\")
| join kind=leftanti (
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(60d) .. ago(LookbackDays))
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceHost.exe"
    | extend LcName2 = tolower(FileName)
    | where LcName2 in (AdfsAssemblyNames)
    | distinct SHA256
) on SHA256
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256, MD5,
          InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessCreationTime
| order by Timestamp desc

let LookbackDays = 14d;
let AdfsAssemblyNames = dynamic([
    @"\microsoft.identityserver.diagnostics.dll",
    @"\microsoft.identityserver.webextension.dll",
    @"\microsoft.identityserver.serviceruntime.dll",
    @"\microsoft.identityserver.servicehost.dll",

]);
let TrustedRoots = dynamic([
    @"\windows\microsoft.net\assembly\",
    @"\windows\assembly\nativeimages_",
    @"\windows\winsxs\",
    @"\program files\active directory federation services\"
]);
WindowsEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 7
| extend Image = tostring(EventData.Image),
         ImageLoaded = tostring(EventData.ImageLoaded),
         Hashes = tostring(EventData.Hashes),
         Signed = tostring(EventData.Signed),
         SignatureStatus = tostring(EventData.SignatureStatus)
| where tolower(Image) endswith @"\microsoft.identityserver.servicehost.exe"
| extend LcLoaded = tolower(ImageLoaded)
| where LcLoaded has_any (AdfsAssemblyNames)
| where not(LcLoaded has_any (TrustedRoots))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Image, ImageLoaded, Hashes, Signed, SignatureStatus
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT29 / FoggyWeb / MagicWeb - AD FS service host loading masqueraded IdentityServer assembly
id: 7e3a1f8b-9e2c-4d1f-b9a1-2c3d4e5f6a7b
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects DLLs that match canonical Microsoft.IdentityServer.* assembly names
  being loaded by Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceHost.exe from non-trusted
  paths (outside the .NET GAC, WinSxS, or the ADFS install directory). This
  is the disk-level signature of NOBELIUM / Midnight Blizzard (APT29 / G0016)
  AD FS backdoors FoggyWeb and MagicWeb.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2021/09/27/foggyweb-targeted-nobelium-malware-leads-to-persistent-backdoor/
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2022/08/24/magicweb-nobeliums-post-compromise-trick-to-authenticate-as-anyone/
author: thn-usecases
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1556.007
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0016
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: image_load
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceHost.exe'
    ImageLoaded|endswith:
      - '\Microsoft.IdentityServer.Diagnostics.dll'
      - '\Microsoft.IdentityServer.WebExtension.dll'
      - '\Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceRuntime.dll'
      - '\Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceHost.dll'
      - '\Microsoft.IdentityServer.Service.dll'
  filter_trusted_paths:
    ImageLoaded|contains:
      - '\Windows\Microsoft.NET\assembly\'
      - '\Windows\assembly\NativeImages_'
      - '\Windows\WinSxS\'
      - '\Program Files\Active Directory Federation Services\'
  condition: selection and not filter_trusted_paths
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate AD FS hotfixes or third-party AD FS extensions deployed from non-standard locations
  - Custom claims providers built by the identity team
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:7 @Image:(*\\Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceHost.exe OR *\\microsoft.identityserver.servicehost.exe OR *\\MICROSOFT.IDENTITYSERVER.SERVICEHOST.EXE) @ImageLoaded:(*\\Microsoft.IdentityServer.Diagnostics.dll OR *\\microsoft.identityserver.diagnostics.dll OR *\\Microsoft.IdentityServer.WebExtension.dll OR *\\microsoft.identityserver.webextension.dll OR *\\Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceRuntime.dll OR *\\microsoft.identityserver.serviceruntime.dll OR *\\Microsoft.IdentityServer.ServiceHost.dll OR *\\microsoft.identityserver.servicehost.dll OR *\\Microsoft.IdentityServer.Service.dll OR *\\microsoft.identityserver.service.dll) -@ImageLoaded:(*\\Windows\\Microsoft.NET\\assembly\\* OR *\\windows\\microsoft.net\\assembly\\* OR *\\Windows\\WinSxS\\* OR *\\windows\\winsxs\\* OR *\\Program Files\\Active Directory Federation Services\\* OR *\\program files\\active directory federation services\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ImageHash ImageFileName=/\\microsoft\.identityserver\.servicehost\.exe$/i
| TargetFileName=/\\microsoft\.identityserver\.(diagnostics|webextension|serviceruntime|servicehost|service)\.dll$/i
| NOT (TargetFileName=/\\windows\\microsoft\.net\\assembly\\/i OR TargetFileName=/\\windows\\assembly\\nativeimages_/i OR TargetFileName=/\\windows\\winsxs\\/i OR TargetFileName=/\\program files\\active directory federation services\\/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, SHA256HashData], function=count())
| _count > 0
